name: any-lover-workspace
description: Any-Lover（角色 Charis）桌宠版 AI 伴侣工作区：frontend（Electron 外壳 + Live2D 前端 + 设置窗口）、backend（上游 Python，黑盒）、site（React 官网）、tooling（构建、打包、发布脚本；产物统一在 out/）。
author: ai-bot

scripts.setup:win: npm run install:app && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run fetch-tha-models && npm run fetch-openseeface
scripts.setup:mac: npm run install:app && npm run prepare-runtime
scripts.install:all: npm run install:app && npm --prefix site install
scripts.dev:setup: npm run install:app && npm run prepare-runtime
scripts.dev: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run frontend:dev
scripts.dist: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build:backend && npm run pack
scripts.dist:full: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build:backend && npm run pack:full
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build:backend && npm run prepare-tha-runtime && node tooling/package.js --no-ollama
